providers.label: Hugging Face (Inference Providers)
providers.notes: One token brokers access to many open-weight providers (Together, Fireworks, Replicate, Sambanova, etc). Cheapest way to try DeepSeek/Qwen/Llama-class models without per-provider signup. The HF V4 Pro route is also the first fallback for the `frontier` tier so a DeepSeek-side blip falls back to the same model on Together.

suggested_models.description: DeepSeek V4 Pro via Together — same model as the first-party frontier target, different provider (fallback for `frontier`)
Qwen3.6 35B via DeepInfra — primary balanced target
Llama 3.3 70B Turbo via Together — cheap general-purpose

providers.label: Anthropic (Claude)
providers.notes: Frontier coding-agent quality. Routed via the dedicated `claude` tier (Opus 4.8 with 1M context, falling back to Sonnet then Haiku) — kept separate from the generic frontier/balanced/cheap tiers so an Anthropic key isn't implicitly required by every request.

suggested_models.description: Opus 4.8 with 1M context — the default for the `claude` tier
Haiku 4.5 — fast and cheap; claude-tier last fallback

providers.label: OpenAI
providers.notes: Frontier general-purpose. GPT-5 family for top-end work, GPT-4.1-mini for cheap.

providers.label: DeepSeek
providers.notes: First-party DeepSeek API — V4 Pro is the default frontier target, V4 Flash the default cheap tier. The legacy `deepseek-chat` and `deepseek-reasoner` model ids are still accepted but slated for deprecation per DeepSeek's docs (they both point at V4 Flash today).

suggested_models.description: DeepSeek V4 Pro — frontier tier default
DeepSeek V4 Flash — cheap tier default
Legacy alias for V4 Flash non-thinking mode (slated for deprecation)
Legacy alias for V4 Flash thinking mode (slated for deprecation)

providers.label: Moonshot AI (Kimi)
providers.notes: Kimi K2 has strong coding chops with long context. Default balanced-tier target.

providers.label: MiniMax
providers.notes: MiniMax exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so route via the openai/ prefix with api_base override. M2 is the current flagship.
